notes: v2.9.28 - Adaptive window sizing for Macs and smaller screens. The background Athena window is no longer held to a preset size: every window placement now adapts to the display that is actually there - its size is capped at the screen's usable area, it always lands fully on-screen (below the Mac menu bar), and stale saved positions from a different monitor setup (e.g. an undocked MacBook) are relocated onto the current display instead of being applied off-screen. Covers both moving and creating windows. Mac fullscreen protection, the keep-active guard against Chrome's Memory Saver unloading the signed-in Athena tab, and everything from v2.9.27's write-safety release are unchanged.
